title: Vitals Metric2 High Value Outliers
dataSources: Symptom logs (`condition:symptom`), medication doses (`medication:dose`), vitals readings (`vitals:reading`), flare-up events (`flareup:event`), lab results (`labresult:value`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management — symptom and medication trackers (Bearable, MyTherapy), connected blood-pressure cuffs and glucometers, and lab-result portals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vitals:metric2 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in vitals metric2 (2) events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme vitals metric2 (2) records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It summarises the unusually high or low value moments in your vitals metric2 (2) history.
